skills.name: skills-library-router
skills.description: Route a task to the right skills-library entry: match a formula by signature, run an ST study, write or run TileLang/CCE bodies, measure an opcode, or draw a trace. Use first, before opening any specific skills-library skill.

skills.name: st-analysis
skills.description: Run a full ST study on a TileLang (or sibling) program: promote a working-best cell through schedule and thread stages, measure single-opcode rates, and write the note up to the head-to-head table. Use when analyzing a kernel's SIMT vs SIMD performance and writing the ANALYSIS report.

skills.name: formula-block-scale
skills.description: Write and check the block-scale formula (one scale for the whole input, then divide): the signature, the SIMT spelling to write vs refuse, measured rows, and the run/read recipe. Use when the code reduces a whole tensor to a single scale factor.

skills.name: formula-column-scale
skills.description: Write and check the column-scale formula (one scale per column, multiply by the inverse): signature, SIMT spelling to write vs refuse, measured rows, and the run/read recipe. Use when a scale is computed per column and applied by multiplication.

skills.name: formula-group-scale-broadcast
skills.description: Write and check the group-scale-broadcast formula (one scale per group, then broadcast-multiply): signature, SIMT spelling to write vs refuse, measured rows, and the run/read recipe. Use when a per-group scale is broadcast back to the group.

skills.name: formula-dot-product
skills.description: Write and check the dot-product formula (one sum per output row) in TileLang and hand-written CCE: signatures, SIMT spellings to write vs refuse, measured rows, and run/read recipes for both shelves. Use when the kernel sums a row or vector down to one scalar per output row.

skills.name: tilelang-run
skills.description: Compile, launch, and read the counters of a TileLang body on Ascend, plus the contiguous-load SIMT reference body. Use when you have a TileLang kernel to run and read its dump, or need the load-pattern reference.

skills.name: cce-run
skills.description: Compile, launch, and read a hand-written CCE body on Ascend, with the __simt_vf__ language reference. Use after writing a CCE body and before measuring it.

skills.name: single-opcode-rate
skills.description: Measure one opcode's busy cycles, IPC, and warps across a thread sweep (128/256/512/1024), and draw the single-opcode/uarch chart. Use to build the uarch reference table for an ST study.

skills.name: cce-opcode-burst
skills.description: Drive a hand-written CCE opcode (LDS, F2F, FFMA, STS) to its best line via the burst ladder, using the reference single-op schedules. Use when tuning a single-opcode CCE schedule against the measured floor.

skills.name: stage-model
skills.description: Build the staged theoretical model (Base → Op-matched → Serial → optional stages) for a case, write the TileLang stage schedules, build a roof, and diagnose a long all-warp 0-IPC hole. Use when the study asks for the theoretical model or a next lever.

skills.name: trace-analysis
skills.description: Pair a recorded trace with its numbers: get one opcode's busy cycles, draw instruction/IPC/warp figures, and lay out result tables. Use when you have a trace dump and need figures or per-opcode numbers.
